title: Selective-Opening Reduction Without Complexity Leveraging
summary: No reduction from selective-opening security for correlated messages to IND-CPA security is known without complexity leveraging; finding one remains open.

formal_statement.body: Can selective-opening security for correlated messages be reduced to IND-CPA security without complexity leveraging?

scope.domain: Security reductions for correlated messages encrypted under different keys with adaptive key corruption.
assumptions: The underlying encryption scheme satisfies IND-CPA security.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove a reduction from selective-opening security to IND-CPA security that avoids complexity leveraging.

citations.label: A Quasipolynomial Reduction for Generalized Selective Decryption on Trees

progress.summary: The source presents this as a notoriously hard problem and states that no reduction to IND-CPA security avoiding complexity leveraging is known.
citation_labels: Georg Fuchsbauer et al., A Quasipolynomial Reduction for Generalized Selective Decryption on Trees
